annotations.title: Get a funder with full details

description: Fetch one Raise Lens funder by slug or raiselens.com/funders URL with full details: website and apply links, AUM or fund size, typical grant size, submission window, programmes and recent grants or investments, plus its name, type, sectors, geographic focus and cheque size. Never includes personal contact details.

url_or_slug.description: A Raise Lens funder slug, or its raiselens.com/funders URL.

name: get_funder_full

access.description: Level of detail in this record: summary or full.

application_note.description: How to approach or apply, as the funder describes it.

cheque_size.description: Usual and largest ticket, in words (USD).

geographic_focus.description: Countries and regions the funder states it covers.

match_reason.description: Why the funder matched the query (name, sector, programme, portfolio, open calls); null without a query.

open_opportunity_count.description: Open grants and calls from this funder listed on Raise Lens.

open_to_applications.description: yes, no or unknown, as the funder states it.

recent_grants.description: Recent grants or investments to organisations.
